caption: The drawing features two solid blue glass objects, each positioned upright against a plain beige background. Both objects are elongated with cylindrical necks, but they differ in shape. The object on the left is a straight, tubular form with a circular opening at the top and gently rounded base. The object on the right has a similar neck but transitions into a bulbous, teardrop-shaped body and leans slightly to the right, with its neck appearing to curve. Both objects are shaded with varieties of deep blue and lighter blue highlights to suggest a glossy, reflective surface. The drawing is signed in the lower right corner with the words "full size P. Ward."
title: Scent Bottle
